title: National Gallery of Singapore Announces Chng Hak-Peng Will Replace Eugene Tan as CEO
summary: Tan, who had served as CEO and director of both the National Gallery of Singapore and the Singapore Art Museum will focuse on his role at SAM.

title: Pots By Enslaved Artist David Drake Returned to Family from Milwaukee Art Museum
summary: The deal was brokered by the Dave the Potter Legacy Trust.

title: Whitney Union Sets Strike Date Days Before Major Roy Lichtenstein Show
summary: The union will start striking on October 5 if they cannot reach a contract agreement with the museum, Local 2110 UAW announced today.

title: Remains of a Roman Temple Discovered in Germany’s Taunus Forest
summary: Storm damage revealed an unusual arrangement of stones that comprised part of a previously unknown settlement near the Roman fort.

title: Rare Working Apple-1 Signed by Steve Wozniak Could Fetch $800,000 at Auction
summary: Fewer than 75 verified Apple-1 computers are known to survive, according to Bonhams, with even fewer remaining operational.

title: At Amant, ‘Sentient Earth’ Redirects the Corporate Gaze to Climate Change
summary: “I think we all can feel it, we’re a bit over the Anthropocene discussion,” said Tobi Maier, head curator at Amant and lead on its newest show.

title: Thomas Kaplan’s 18th Rembrandt is St John on Patmos
summary: The owner of the Leiden Collection is revealed to have bought the painting for $18 million at auction at Sotheby’s in December 2025.

title: Pace Gallery Is Seeking a Tenant for Part of Its New York Headquarters
summary: A Pace spokesperson confirmed that the gallery is exploring bringing another tenant into the building, though emphasized that the move would not affect its exhibition spaces.

title: ‘We Can Literally Be in Two Places at Once’: Vancouver Art Gallery Elevates Eva Respini and Sirish Rao to Co-CEOs
summary: Respini will also be chief curator, while Rao will serve as executive director.

title: Ann Temkin to Step Down as MoMA’s Chief Painting and Sculpture Curator After 18 Years
summary: She will transition into a newly created position as an adviser to director Christophe Cherix, ahead of MoMA's centennial in 2029.
